title: Travel Dokodemo Door
description: Adds 3 doors that allow you to teleport far away.
body:
**You can go everywhere! Though you can't choose where!**

This is a port of Tsuteto's [TravelDokodemoDoor](https://tsuteto.hacca.jp/mcmods#dkdmdoors).

## Doors
![Red Door](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4bc9357eaa22a3dbedc6f4b3eee55a6d07a8c1c.png)(Anywhere Travel One-Way Door) - Pass through this to take you far away.

![Blue Door](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afa49d4b9531abc1ef36dfcc57cf3c5e1d8c2d7e.png)(Anywhere Travel Door) - Same as the red one, but this one places another door at the destination so that you can get back.

![White Door](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/384c1576e57a435d5779e3959f9d12f9f84ebb4a.png)(Anywhere Short Trip Door) - Same as the blue one, but closer.
